## 2.1 Librairies

```{r 2.1.1}
#install.packages("RSelenium")
#install.packages("xlsx")
library(RSelenium)
library(binman)
library(stringr)
library(xlsx)
library(dplyr)

```


chromeversion:

Create a string path to the chrome application folder where there is a folder that contains the version number. 
String extract the version number on that folder and replace all dots with a \\. (you need another backslash to escape the backslash) to use it in the next str_extract.

chromedriver:

String extract all the matches of the object chromeversion added with another digit paste0(chromeversions, '\\d+') from the string resulting from list_versions("chromedriver) (this is a binman function), convert to numeric versions and get the lowest version min() or alternatively the highest using max().

(Danny-dK, source:https://github.com/ropensci/RSelenium/issues/198)

```{r 2.1.2}

chromeversion <- toString(dir(path = 'C:/Program Files (x86)/Google/Chrome/Application/')) %>% 
                 str_extract(., '^\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+\\.') %>% 
                 str_replace_all(., '\\.', '\\\\.')  

chromedriver <-  str_extract_all(toString(list_versions("chromedriver")), paste0(chromeversion, '\\d+'), simplify = TRUE) %>% 
                 as.numeric_version(.) %>% 
                 min(.)

```

## 2.2 Ouvrir le navigateur distant


```{r 2.2.1}

#cprof <- getChromeProfile(dataDir = "C:/Users/franc/AppData/Local/Google/Chrome", profileDir = "Profile 2")
download_path = file.path(getwd(),'Downloads')
dir.create(download_path, recursive = TRUE)

eCaps <- list(
  chromeOptions = 
    list(args = c('--no-sandbox', '--disable-gpu', '--start-maximized','--disable-popup-blocking','--disable-extensions'),
         prefs = list(
           "profile.default_content_settings.popups" = 0L,
           "profile.default_content_setting_values.automatic_downloads" = 1L,
           "download.prompt_for_download" = FALSE,
           "download.directory_upgrade" = TRUE,
           "safebrowsing.enabled" = TRUE,
           "safebrowsing.disable_download_protection" = TRUE,
           "download.default_directory" = str_replace_all(download_path, '/', '\\\\')
           )
         )
  )

driver <- rsDriver(browser = "chrome", port = 4567L, geckover = NULL, 
                   chromever =  toString(chromedriver), iedrver = NULL, 
                   phantomver = NULL, verbose = FALSE, extraCapabilities = eCaps)

remDr <- driver$client

```


```{r cars}

remDr$navigate("https://journals.openedition.org/aad/2969")
Sys.sleep(2)
next_issue = TRUE

while (next_issue) {
  current_issue = unlist(remDr$getCurrentUrl())
  vol_title = unlist(remDr$findElement('xpath','.//span[@class="title"]')$getElementText())
  vol_dir = unlist(remDr$findElement('xpath','.//div[@id="publiDirector"]')$getElementText())
  articles_links = remDr$findElements('xpath', '//div[@class="title"]/a') %>%
  sapply(., function(article_link){article_link$getElementAttribute("href")})
  #articles_links = sapply(articles_links, function(article_link){article_link$getElementAttribute("href")})
  for (article_link in articles_links) {
    article_link = unlist(article_link)
    remDr$navigate(article_link)
    Sys.sleep(2)
    pdf_link = unlist(remDr$findElement('xpath','.//a[@id="wDownload"]')$getElementAttribute("href"))
    row_id=nrow(df)+1
    df[row_id,] = ''
    df[row_id,'Vol_title'] = vol_title
    df[row_id,'Vol_dir'] = vol_dir
    df[row_id,'XML'] = unlist(remDr$getPageSource())
    df[row_id,'XML_URL'] = article_link
    df[row_id,'PDF_URL'] = pdf_link
    df[row_id,'Time'] = as.character(Sys.time())
    # remDr$navigate(pdf_link)
    # Sys.sleep(10)
    # tmpshot = fileSnapshot(download_path)
    # latest_file = rownames(tmpshot$info[which.max(tmpshot$info$mtime),]) %>%
    # file.path(download_path,.)
    # new_name = file.path(download_path,paste(row_id,sep='','.pdf'))
    # file.rename(latest_file,new_name)
  }
  remDr$navigate(current_issue)
  Sys.sleep(2)
  next_issue = tryCatch(
    expr = {
      next_issue_link = unlist(remDr$findElement('xpath','.//a[@class="goNext"]')$getElementAttribute("href"))
      remDr$navigate(next_issue_link)
      TRUE
    },
    error = function(e){return(FALSE)}
    )
  }
  

```

## Fermer le navigateur distant

```{r cars}
#remDr$close()
driver$server$stop() 
rm(remDr)
gc()
```
